title: Core AI Overview
summary: Introduces the major branches of AI, including reasoning, learning, search, and perception.
content: Artificial intelligence combines reasoning, learning, search, perception, and planning into systems that can solve useful tasks. Machine learning helps models improve from data, while symbolic techniques organize explicit knowledge and rules. Modern AI applications often combine retrieval, generation, and evaluation so their outputs stay grounded in source material. This overview gives beginners a map of the field before they explore specialized topics.
